disambiguation: Supports Markdown only, unlike some outline tools that handle Canvas or PDF.
extras: Rewritten with zero UI framework (native DOM) for improved performance on large documents.
intentEvidence: XU Quiet Outline is a lightweight outline plugin forked and trimmed from Quiet Outline (MIT).
motivation: To create a lightweight, high-performance outline plugin by replacing the original UI framework with native DOM rendering.
problem: Performance issues and slow loading times when using large Markdown documents with existing outline plugins.
